'''Lol Wikma''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] who worked for [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. They worked at [[Refinery 435]], and were interviewed by [[Imperial HoloVision]] in the wake of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] attack on the facility.
